name: ClinVar_get_submitted_records
description: Retrieve the individual per-submitter assertions (SCV / ClinicalAssertion records) for a ClinVar variant. Unlike ClinVar_search_variants / ClinVar_get_variant_details / ClinVar_get_clinical_significance (which use esummary and return only the single AGGREGATE germline classification), this tool calls NCBI eutils efetch (rettype=vcv) and parses the full VariationArchive XML to expose every submitter's own classification, review status, condition and last-evaluated date. Use this when you need to see who classified a variant and how (e.g. to inspect conflicting interpretations behind a 'Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity' aggregate). Keyless NCBI endpoint. Each submission also carries whether ClinVar counted it in the aggregate classification (contributes_to_aggregate_classification), how the observation was collected, the allele origin and affected status, the assertion method and cited PubMed ids, and -- where the submitter gave them -- sex, age bounds and HPO clinical features.

variant_id.description: ClinVar variant identifier. Accepts a VCV accession (e.g. 'VCV000013961') OR a bare ClinVar variation id (e.g. '13961'); a numeric id is normalized to VCV%09d. Example: 'VCV000013961' (BRAF V600E).

name.description: ClinVar preferred variant name (e.g. HGVS expression).

aggregate_classification.description: Record-level aggregate germline classification description (e.g. 'Pathogenic', 'Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity').

classification.description: This submitter's classification value (e.g. 'Pathogenic' for germline, 'Tier I - Strong' for somatic clinical impact, 'Oncogenic' for oncogenicity).

classification_type.description: Which classification axis the value belongs to: 'germline', 'somatic_clinical_impact', or 'oncogenicity'.

review_status.description: This submitter's review status (e.g. 'criteria provided, single submitter').

condition.description: Condition / phenotype the submitter classified against.

last_evaluated.description: Date the submitter last evaluated the classification (YYYY-MM-DD).

submitter_org_id.description: ClinVar organization id for the submitter.

date_last_updated.description: Date this assertion was last updated.

contributes_to_aggregate_classification.description: Whether ClinVar counted this submission in the record-level aggregate_classification -- the C/N badge in the ClinVar UI. Submissions that disagree with the aggregate are often the ones excluded, so a caller comparing submitters needs it. On VCV000013961, 23 of 45 submissions contribute.

assertion_method.description: The guideline the submitter classified under, e.g. 'ACMG Guidelines, 2015'.

citations.description: PubMed ids this submission's classification cites.

collection_methods.description: How the observation was made, e.g. 'clinical testing', 'literature only', 'curation'. Present on every submission of VCV000013961.

origins.description: Allele origin as the submitter reported it, e.g. 'germline', 'somatic', 'unknown'.

affected_status.description: Whether the observed individuals were affected: 'yes', 'no', 'unknown'.

sex.description: Reported sex of the observed individuals, when given.

ages.description: Reported age bounds, when given. ClinVar sends minimum and maximum as separate entries.

clinical_features.description: Phenotypes observed in the submitted case, as HPO cross-references.

hpo_id.description: Human Phenotype Ontology id, e.g. HP:0000543.

families_with_variant.description: Number of families reported with the variant, when given.

name: ClinVar_search_by_region
description: Find ClinVar variants that OVERLAP a genomic region, including large copy-number variants that begin far outside it. Use this for 'which variant is located at chr:start-end' questions: Entrez's chrpos search matches a variant's START position, so a narrow window misses a pathogenic CNV that spans the region but starts megabases upstream (an 11 bp search at chr7:155593770-155593780 returns nothing, though a 1.5 Mb pathogenic loss covers it). The search therefore widens the window upstream by 'margin' and keeps only records whose span genuinely overlaps; records Entrez indexes as single-base are excluded from the upstream part of that window, since a one-base variant starting outside the region cannot reach into it. Results are sorted smallest span first within each candidate page. Completeness is reported, not assumed: 'total_available' (also 'candidate_total') is Entrez's own count for the search, 'n_candidates' is how many of those records were fetched and checked for overlap in this candidate page, and 'truncated' is true (with a 'truncation_note') when the second number is smaller than the first -- in that case an empty or short 'variants' list is NOT evidence that nothing overlaps the region. Pagination is two-dimensional: exhaust next_result_offset within the current candidate page, then advance next_candidate_offset; aggregate every candidate page before making global completeness or smallest-span claims.

region.description: Region as written, e.g. 'chr7:155593770-155593780'. Alternative to chrom/start/end.

assembly.description: Assembly the coordinates are in. Default GRCh37.

margin.description: How far upstream to look for variants that start before the region and span into it. Default 2000000. Raising it costs few extra candidates because single-base records upstream are filtered out, so it is a safe way to reach larger spanning CNVs -- unless 'truncated' is already true, in which case a wider window only makes the truncation worse.

max_results.description: Maximum overlapping variants to return from this candidate page; the full number found in the page is reported as 'n_overlapping'. Default 50.

result_offset.description: Offset within overlaps found in the current candidate page. Follow next_result_offset first.

candidate_limit.description: Number of Entrez candidates to inspect in this page.

candidate_offset.description: Entrez candidate offset. Advance to next_candidate_offset after exhausting result pages.

term.description: The Entrez query that was executed.

total_available.description: Entrez's own count of records matching 'term' -- the size of the full match set, not the number inspected. Null if esearch did not report a count.

n_candidates.description: How many matching records this call actually fetched summaries for and checked for overlap. Capped per call, which is what 'truncated' reports.

truncated.description: True when n_candidates is less than total_available, i.e. the region was only partially scanned and 'variants' may be missing overlapping records.

truncation_note.description: Present only when 'truncated' is true: states how many of how many records were inspected and why the omitted ones are not the least relevant.

n_overlapping.description: How many of the inspected records genuinely overlap the region. Larger than len(variants) when capped by 'max_results'.

variants.description: Overlapping variants, smallest span first, capped at 'max_results'.

title.description: ClinVar record title (HGVS expression or cytogenetic CNV name).

obj_type.description: Variant type, e.g. 'single nucleotide variant', 'copy number loss'.

start.description: Placement start in the requested assembly.

stop.description: Placement stop in the requested assembly.

span.description: stop - start + 1, the number of bases the variant covers.

genes.description: The genes the variant covers, capped at GENES_PER_OVERLAP_ROW. A 668 kb pathogenic deletion hits five of them and a 30 kb one hits SHH; the span alone said neither

gene_id.description: NCBI Gene id, the field a caller joins on

source.description: 'submitted' when the submitter asserted the gene, 'calculated' when ClinVar derived it from the coordinates - a different claim

gene_count.description: How many genes the record lists, before the cap. ClinVar 147398 lists 696

review_status.description: How well-reviewed the classification is, e.g. 'criteria provided, single submitter'

accession.description: ClinVar accession, e.g. VCV001807779 - how the record is cited and fetched

note.description: How the widened-window search works and what the counts mean.

candidate_total.description: Candidates Entrez reports for the term

candidate_has_more.description: Whether more candidates remain to inspect

matched_in_candidate_page.description: How many of this candidate page overlapped the region
